lines.text: It’s project time! Make a treasure hunt in ScratchJr: plan a map, start with the green flag, walk to the treasure, say something when it’s found, test and fix, and share.
Your pirate walks around an island, finds treasure and says something when it’s found.
Draw the island, the treasure and the path with arrows first.
When the pirate finds the treasure, add a say block: “I found it!”.
If the pirate goes the wrong way, change one block and try again.
Collect both treasures, say “I found it!”, and finish on the star.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
